## v1.1.0 - 2026-09-16

### Changes

- Consolidate x64dbg tools into 16 grouped operations and repair the static/dynamic crossover ([#10](https://github.com/Sarks0/binary-mcp/pull/10))
- Security hardening: path confinement, command gates, installer integrity, untrusted-output fencing ([#3](https://github.com/Sarks0/binary-mcp/pull/3))

- Add project reuse and targeted decompiles for large binaries ([#6](https://github.com/Sarks0/binary-mcp/pull/6))
- diff + jobs: coverage examinations, a usable diff_binaries, and a cross-process job registry ([#5](https://github.com/Sarks0/binary-mcp/pull/5))
- coverage: make binary-mcp the source of truth for per-binary review coverage ([#4](https://github.com/Sarks0/binary-mcp/pull/4))
- fix(security): audit remediation items 1-3 + unified cache root ([#2](https://github.com/Sarks0/binary-mcp/pull/2))
- chore: remove author byline from installers ([d7e3c8e](https://github.com/Sarks0/binary-mcp/commit/d7e3c8ed1c6e686d6b35801d5b37485ea7c59170))
